instruction: I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.
notes: Two apps besides supervisor: simple_note (find/read/update the log note) and spotify (look up release dates). spotify.search_songs is a public API (no access_token), so no spotify login is required; one search per song that still lacks a RELEASED_AT entry. The number of un-annotated songs is unknown a priori; the problem uses 4 placeholder missing songs (song-3..song-6, queries bound at runtime from the note lines) and 2 already-annotated songs (song-1, song-2, known-release-month in :init), which yields the 10-call reference plan. Since quantified preconditions are disallowed, 'all missing songs looked up' is encoded with a discrete counter (lookups-done/next-count/missing-count) that update_note must reach. The goal demands a single update_note on the located note with the composed content (only the content field changes), and supervisor-complete-task (no answer) takes the note/content records as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal.
